thread:
Ava Patel: :warning: Heads up — onboarding is failing for 3 new accounts (Acme Health, BlueFin, Ledgerly) after the 03:12 infra deploy. Customers see SSO failing on the final callback with a 500 from auth-service. Marking as onboarding-blocker; CCing sales and eng.
Ravi Singh: Investigating with eng-runtime. Initial traces show TLS cert validation errors in auth-service; might be the rotation job. @Michael Chen can you confirm if the rotation ran this morning?
Michael Chen: Confirmed. Rotation ran but the push step to prod failed with this error:
```json
{"error":"permission denied","service":"cert-rotator","env":"prod"}
```
I'm kicking a hotfix to re-push certs to the affected instances. ETA ~15m.
deploy-bot: :truck: deploy started by Michael Chen — hotfix/cert-rotator -> prod
Sara Gomez: Thanks — I'm preparing a customer update. Draft below, please tweak:
"Hi <customer>, we're investigating an issue causing SSO failures during onboarding. We're applying a fix and will follow up with an RCA. No customer data was exposed. We'll keep you updated every 30 minutes."
Ava Patel: Good start. Add: who to contact (CSM + support), and offer to reschedule onboarding if needed. Also flag renewal risk: Acme Health onboarding is scheduled for next week — if not fully onboarded, renewal conversation may be impacted.
Ravi Singh: Hotfix applied. Validation shows certs pushed and auth-service restarted. Running smoke tests now.
Michael Chen: Smoke OK: onboarding flows pass end-to-end on prod-canary. Rolling to full prod. Please confirm with customers once you see success.
Sara Gomez: Quick check with Acme and BlueFin — both report onboarding flows progressing. Ledgerly still needs manual SAML assertion update; scheduling a 30m call with them now. I'll include a credit offer for the inconvenience and note escalation path.
Ava Patel: Thanks team. Action items: 1) Sara to send targeted customer updates + offer (Acme, BlueFin, Ledgerly) — once confirmed, close thread. 2) Michael/Ravi to open RCA draft: cert-rotator didn't propagate due to missing IAM role; add automation test and alert. 3) Sales notified re: renewal risk for Acme.
Michael Chen: RCA draft: root cause = rotation job lost write perms after a permissions policy change during maintenance; fallback path didn't retry; fix = add idempotent retry + unit test + deploy-time check. I'll push the PR and ping eng-runtime for review.
Ava Patel: I'll own outbound comms this cycle and schedule the postmortem. Please add any customer feedback you capture in-thread. :white_check_mark:
Sara Gomez: Update at 1755559005 — Acme & BlueFin onboarded successfully; Ledgerly call scheduled for 1755559300. Sending customer emails now. Closing as mitigated, RCA in progress. :email:
